rules.statement: The bridge must preserve HNONSEC and translate supported HPROT fields per §6.3.

rules.condition: When a transfer is Shareable or uses an unsupported HPROT combination
rules.statement: The bridge must reject Shareable transfers and unsupported HPROT combinations.
The bridge must not implement address-based access control.
The bridge must reject transfers with HMASTLOCK; exclusive/atomic access is not implemented.
The AXI lock outputs must be tied low.
AHB parity must be disabled and no ECC may be added to data or FIFOs.
The bridge must use one shared clock and reset, with no CDC or independent reset domains.

rules.condition: When an AXI response error occurs
rules.statement: AXI response errors must be returned on AHB.
The bridge must not add any timeout or retry.
